meta.title: Privacy Policy | Sitepow Store
meta.description: Personal Data Protection Policy of Sitepow Store compliant with the Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) for maximum transparency and security.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: Sitepow Co., Ltd. attaches great importance to the protection of your personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information under the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (PDPA).

intro.title: 1. Introduction and Scope of Policy
intro.p1: This Privacy Policy governs the collection, use, and disclosure of personal data belonging to users of Sitepow Store, including store owners (Merchants), store administrators, employees, end customers purchasing goods through storefronts or POS, and general website visitors.
intro.p2: Sitepow acts as a "Data Controller" for merchant account credentials and platform service records, and serves as a "Data Processor" for order details and customer data imported by merchants into our system.

collection.title: 2. Personal Data We Collect
collection.p1: We collect personal data only to the extent necessary for service provision, categorized as follows:
collection.item1: Identity & Contact Data: Full name, email address, telephone number, store name, shipping or tax invoice addresses
collection.item2: Account & Verification Data: Password (stored via one-way cryptographic hash), tax identification number, ID documents required for payment activation
collection.item3: Orders & Transaction Data: Order history, transaction amounts, payment slips (full credit card details are never stored on our servers; payments utilize tokenization through PCI-DSS certified payment gateways)
collection.item4: Technical & Usage Data: IP address, browser type and version, operating system, timestamped access logs, and cookie identifiers

purpose.title: 3. Legal Basis and Purposes of Processing
purpose.p1: We process personal data under contractual necessity, legal compliance, legitimate interest, and consent where required, for the following purposes:
purpose.item1: To provide e-commerce management, point-of-sale (POS), inventory control, and order fulfillment systems
purpose.item2: To process payments, verify bank transfer slips, and reconcile accounts
purpose.item3: To send real-time order status notifications via Webhook, email, SMS, or automated chat
purpose.item4: To ensure platform security, prevent unauthorized access, detect fraud, and mitigate cyber threats
purpose.item5: To fulfill statutory obligations under tax, accounting, and electronic commerce laws of Thailand

disclosure.title: 4. Third-Party Data Disclosure
disclosure.p1: We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal data to external third parties for marketing purposes. Data is shared strictly as necessary with the following entities:
disclosure.item1: Cloud infrastructure and hosting providers (e.g., Supabase, AWS, Google Cloud) certified with international security standards
disclosure.item2: Licensed financial institutions and payment processors (e.g., Stripe, GB Prime Pay, Thai commercial banks)
disclosure.item3: Couriers and logistics service providers integrated by merchants for automated shipping
disclosure.item4: Law enforcement or competent regulatory authorities when mandated by applicable law or court order

security.title: 5. Data Security Measures
security.p1: We implement robust technical and organizational measures to safeguard your personal data against loss, unauthorized access, destruction, or disclosure:
security.item1: End-to-end data encryption in transit using 256-bit TLS/SSL protocols
security.item2: Strong cryptographic hashing algorithms with salted keys for password storage
security.item3: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and immutable administrative audit logs
security.item4: Automated encrypted cloud backups and comprehensive disaster recovery protocols

retention.title: 6. Data Retention Period
retention.p1: We retain personal data for as long as your account remains active or as needed to provide our services.
retention.p2: Financial records and tax invoices are retained in accordance with statutory accounting and tax regulations (generally 5 to 10 years). Following the retention period, data is securely erased or destroyed.

rights.title: 7. Your Rights as a Data Subject (PDPA)
rights.p1: Under the Thailand Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562, you are entitled to exercise the following legal rights:
rights.item1: Right to access and obtain a copy of your personal data
rights.item2: Right to rectification of inaccurate, incomplete, or misleading data
rights.item3: Right to erasure, deletion, or destruction of personal data (Right to be Forgotten)
rights.item5: Right to object to data processing
rights.item6: Right to withdraw consent at any time
rights.item7: Right to data portability to another data controller

cookies.title: 8. Cookie Policy
cookies.p1: We use strictly necessary cookies to maintain user sessions, remember language preferences, and protect form submissions against CSRF attacks.
cookies.p2: You may configure your browser settings to reject or delete cookies. However, disabling essential cookies may hinder access to certain features and administrative consoles.

updates.title: 9. Updates to this Policy
updates.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect operational, legal, or regulatory changes. Any modifications become effective immediately upon publication on this page.
